curation.reason: Append source-reviewed original vehicle schematics, exact informational operator labels, verified origin assertions and recognizable national marks without changing frozen inputs. Exact unresolved model/design, current/worldwide, small-island, pad, native and release obligations remain open.

features: FAA2017 PDFp166-167 depicts the crewed Shenzhou Long March2F stack with four boosters and launch escape tower. The generic payload-only2F/T external profile is not substituted.
coverage.limitations: Original source-dated schematic, not engineering reconstruction, launch photography, exact paintwork, or event-specific option selection. Published overall/core dimensions set aspect ratios where stated; fairing lengths, unpublished fairing diameters and collar stations are illustrative image proportions, not measured dimensions. Flattened side-booster layout shows the total count, not a physical perspective. Provider lifecycle flags and exact configuration labels are retained.

facts.creator: SpaceFox contributors
facts.credit: Original SpaceFox informational artwork. No third-party graphic bytes or official logo are redistributed.

geometryReference.basis: Rendering parameters: overall length/core diameter from cited specifications except Eris25m earlier-programme/image scale and BlackBrantIX representative16m canvas. Fairing length and unpublished fairing diameter are approximate inspected-image proportions; collars are illustrative. Not engineering or surveyed geometry.

radialProjection.basis: CNSA gives 58.34 m, 3.35 m core, four 2.25 m boosters and 3.8 m fairing; tower/booster/fairing lengths approximated from ascent illustration.
